notes: Statement change, equivalent: the hypothesis `Submodule.IsLattice F Y` of `dual_lattice_denom` becomes `Submodule.IsFullLattice F Y`. Mathlib #44365 renamed the pinned `IsLattice` (finitely generated and spanning) to `IsFullLattice` and reused the name `IsLattice` for a weaker notion without `span_eq_top`. Here `F` is the fraction field of `A` (`[IsFractionRing A F]`), so `IsFullLattice F Y ↔ Y.FG ∧ span F Y = ⊤`, which is the pinned definition, because `Submodule.IsLattice.of_fg` supplies the new linear-independence field. The proof is unchanged.
